_comment: Gate policy for site-security. A site repo can override with .security/policy.json. Severities: critical, high, medium, low, info.

brochure._comment: Static or mostly static marketing sites (Astro, Vite, plain HTML). OWASP ASVS Level 1 baseline.

app._comment: Sites with auth, a database, payments or personal data (Next.js + Supabase, Stripe). OWASP ASVS Level 2 baseline.
